newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek bonds upbeat, ecu/drachma hits new year highs.
newsitem.headline: Greek bonds upbeat, ecu/drachma hits new year highs.

text.p: Greek bonds registered fresh gains, short depos were softer, forex forwards were steady and ecu/drachma hit new year highs before receding to 311.55/65 in late dealings, traders said.
"Bonds have gained another 50 basis points in terms of price in late dealings," a bond dealer at a foreign bank said. "FRNs and zeros are also firmer but the big move was in fixed coupon bonds."
The finance ministry cut three-, six- and 12-month T-bill rates by 60 basis points to 8.6 percent, 8.9 and 9.7 percent respectively on Wednesday sparking a bond rally.
Short depos are softer and forex forwards are little changed, dealers said.
Bank of Greece drained 200 billion drachmas of 14-day funds at 11.90 percent in today's depo auction.
Ecu/drachma recorded fresh year highs at 311.70 before receding to 311.55/65, forex dealer said.
Some traders said ecu/drachma could test 314 and mark/drachma 161 in the short-run but other said ecu/drachma had peaked at these levels.
The mark was quoted at 159.80/90 from Friday's 159.480 fix, the dollar at 272.09/19 drachmas from 272.210 and the ecu at 311.70/80 from 311.200 drachmas.
